reserveReview.rationale: The exact live ERC-4626 row measures 100% deployed strategy accounting with zero idle USDC. YieldFi's yUSD terms identify the Series as market-neutral and delta-neutral positions across whitelisted DeFi protocols and hedged venues and permit leverage, while official transparency materials provide no current itemized exposure. The aggregate is classified as a high-risk protocol position without inventing look-through allocation or tracked-coin links.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: yUSD token terms expressly permit borrowing and leverage looping, private LP deals, hedged carry and basis strategies; the documented fund flow deploys deposited Series assets into DeFi or exchange strategy accounts. Capital reuse is permitted, not prohibited. This is a contractual permission finding, not a measured allocation or assertion of actual current leverage. ForDeFi is named as an MPC provider; provider shares, enforceable segregation and insolvency treatment across the entire strategy book remain unverified.
